info.title: Wheelwright foundational domain — isolated candidate
info.description: NOT operative OAS or runtime. Principal-reviewed working rules, provisional engineering choices and source gaps are documented in this directory. No new write operation. Reused Artifact upload/reprocessing and quote acquisition remain their existing bounded contracts, not authority to invoke them. Position evaluations remain embedded; optional Portfolio/Execution/evaluation roots deferred. Alpha semantics may be replaced; valid source evidence is preserved.

servers.description: Contract address space only; no candidate server exists.

get.description: Authenticate token User before validation. Enforce exact applicable Account capability on direct reads, all links, constituents, source records, historical/Audit records and every expanded projection; user ownership never bypasses Account grants. Collection filters narrow scope only. Unknown/duplicate query fields or GET bodies return 422. Collection cursor is opaque, bound to caller grants/filter/sort/projection; grant revocation is rechecked on continuation. Stable order ends in canonical ID; cursors do not promise atomic cross-broker time. Default page size 50, maximum 200. Financial status is independent of HTTP success. All private responses use private,no-store.

Decimal.description: Exact base-10 value; never binary floating point. No NaN/Infinity. Unit is explicit on containing field.

ExactNumber.description: Exact coordinate or affine coefficient; rational form permits nonterminating decimal roots.

Link.description: Server-generated canonical address. Clients follow links or centralized contract-aware routing; query parameters may be constructed as documented. Link possession grants nothing.

Currency.description: Reported/qualified currency code; missing currency is not inferred from a dollar-labelled CSV column.

SourceRef.description: Immutable recoverable evidence locator. Null source time remains unknown; receipt is never substituted. BACKEND_ASSERTION refers to retained Wheelwright authority, not manufactured broker evidence.

Remediation.description: Guidance, not permission. Current refresh cannot supply a missing historical quote.

Warning.description: Representation data, not a warning resource. affected uses JSON Pointers relative to the representation carrying this warning; adapters rebase pointers for projections.

asOf.description: Evaluation target time, if established/requested. Actual component observation times remain in evidence; this is never a substitute for them.

Metric.description: NOT_APPLICABLE is a known non-applicability, distinct from missing evidence, and may have no warning. Known nonzero and unknown zero must never be conflated.

BrokerAlias.description: Provider-qualified identifier, not a Position occurrence ID. Equivalence across brokers requires evidence.

OptionTerms.description: Standard intrinsic requires positively verified terms. Same symbol/expiry/strike/right alone does not prove equal deliverables. Adjusted terms remain visible even when payoff is unsupported. Individually missing terms remain null while known terms survive; qualification prevents standard payoff claims. This is not permission to guess a multiplier.

Instrument.description: Provisional unified Instrument family: an OPTION is an independently addressable derivative Contract. No second Contract identity or universal cross-broker master. Shared representations contain public/provider reference terms only. Private Account-supplied terms/provenance stay in authorized holdings and Construction leaves.

SourceInventory.description: Read-only projection of the linked BrokerHolding at a specified snapshot/cut. Copies must equal that authoritative observation. SourceInventory is not an independent writable holding store or lot identity.

basis.description: Nonnegative magnitude of attributable original acquisition cost/premium for this owned quantity, excluding fees. Side determines cash-flow sign: LONG opening flow = -basis, SHORT = +basis. Cash balance is principal, not opening trade income. Not a tax-lot allocator.

Allocation.description: Owned allocation only. Aggregate current allocations across every Position reconcile against this source cut; historical predecessors are not current allocations. Cost-sum preservation does not establish lot attribution.

CompositionGroup.description: Finite recursive inline composition. Empty group may represent evidenced zero held exposure at closure. No cycles, duplicated ownership or invented nested Position identity. Shared subordinate economics must be referenced as relationships, not owned twice. Inline subordinate Constructions may identify an exact modelVersion without acquiring separate Position identity. Child quantities are absolute actual quantities, not another package scaling multiplier.

FinancialRelationship.description: Aggregate economic coverage and broker-enforced reservation are different claims. This relationship references existing owned inventory; it never allocates it a second time. Distinct obligation quantities are aggregated once per coverageSetId. No tax-lot/share-to-call selection is asserted.

predecessor.description: Immediate preceding retained Construction instance when known, never a shortcut to original. Availability of intermediate instances is a source/runtime truth obligation; references must not invent a contiguous history.

predecessorStatus.description: Immediate instance association status; UNKNOWN with null predecessor never asserts a shortcut to original.

Construction.description: Write-once composition assertion. Evidence correction is explicitly distinguished from an actual exposure transition. Quote ticks/time/unfilled Orders do not change composition. Exact modelVersion is immutable; no mutable latest alias.

ModelRole.description: Relative role ratio is dimensional: option contract count/child package count; shares and cash bind evidenced coverage quantities. Nested Model references resolve exact immutable versions.

ModelConstraint.description: Constraints apply transitively to bound descendants. STRIKE_ORDER lists roles in required order. A family label or shape never establishes common membership.

ModelVersion.description: Write-once declarative definition. Revision creates a new URI. Standard option intrinsic is signed quantity * multiplier * max(S-K,0) or max(K-S,0); cash constant and shares linear. Basis/premium subtraction requires separately qualified inputs. No glyph templates.

AffineSegment.description: y = slope*S + intercept on [lower,upper); null upper means +infinity. S>=0. Continuous shared endpoints have equal values; exact boundary values below remove endpoint ambiguity.

Geometry.description: Backend-provided exact aggregate function, including unequal tails. Slopes have valueCurrency per unit of underlying price; intercepts/value use valueCurrency. No loss of geometry to CLI glyphs. Does not describe an executable closing price or early-exercise path.

Timeline.description: Remaining days use the accepted nonnegative NY calendar convention; original days require final verified opening fill. Receipt time is never opening time. openedAt, originalDays, openingEvidence and related lifecycle timestamps independently require their source capabilities; an Order timestamp is never a public Position fact by default.

RangeEvaluation.description: Verified strike geometry, not breakeven or general trading preference.

ManualCheckpoint.description: Verified target+GTD convention; neither notification nor automatic close is established.

ManagementEvaluation.description: Does not impose Strategy or Regime. Current P/L and targets retain exact signed values beyond any terminal viewport. Missing stop never becomes theoretical max loss; no protective stop requires positively complete reconciled Order evidence.

allOf.description: Optional qualified historical comparison when explicitly relevant; no universal asOf/replay endpoint or historic-data availability guarantee is introduced.
Reported source P/L retained in its own financial dialect. Do not promote into grossUnrealizedPl without establishing compatible basis/fee/currency conventions.

Evaluation.description: Signed Account cash flow: positive received, negative paid, totals in declared currency for actual bound quantity. openingCashFlow + estimatedClosingCashFlow = gross unrealized P/L for remaining exposure. Fees are nonnegative outflow magnitudes; net = gross - applicable fees, unknown fees do not mean zero. Realized P/L consumes actual attributed closing evidence, never a quote or holdings difference. Gross and net, realized and unrealized remain distinct. Cash balance is not profit. No credit-only convention.

establishedAtAccess.description: Field-level source permission for the establishment clock. Redaction preserves the independently authorized lifecycle assertion, not the private event timestamp.

LifecycleEvidence.description: Resource CLOSED is terminal, but evidence must separately establish closure. Missing continuity must not manufacture a close, reopen or governed applicability.

included.description: Optional authorized collection/instance expansion; same immutable identities and scope. Missing expansions are not missing domain objects.

Position.description: Independent Wheelwright GUID. Reopening after CLOSED creates a different GUID even for identical source series. No public lifecycle write endpoint. UNRESOLVED is a provisional evidence state, not a fourth trading lifecycle. Split/recombine remains unratified.

Fill.description: Reported fill only. quantity is actual filled units; price is a nonnegative magnitude in currency. PER_UNDERLYING_UNIT multiplies contract quantity and verified multiplier; PER_CONTRACT multiplies quantity; TOTAL_LEG is already sized. Cash flow sign comes from action. UNKNOWN units prohibit deriving cash totals.

Order.description: Observed trader instruction only; no submission, amendment, cancel or trade generation. Trigger and execution limit differ. Unfilled/expired/canceled instructions never change held exposure. Broker group ID is an attribute; preserve reconciled child Orders.

MarketObservation.description: Immutable source quote observation; Account-specific observations require Account grants. Shared observations require market.read. Source time and receipt are distinct. Underlying and option observations are separate; no universal historical availability claim.

AllocationBalance.description: Global current owned allocations over one evidence cut. residual = source magnitude - allocated; negative residual is a conflict, never forced to zero. Historical roots not summed again; source-qualified collateral references do not allocate twice.

InventoryReconciliation.description: Account representation subview, not a new resource. Incomplete coverage prevents asserting availability or globally reconciled truth.

AuditRecord.description: Optional immutable Wheelwright record. Does not assert complete brokerage history or replace Construction predecessor navigation.

ResourceURI.description: URI-only projection contains no financial conclusion; no financial warnings need to be reconstructed from it.

included.description: Optional authorized collection/instance expansion; same immutable identities and scope. Missing expansions are not missing domain objects.

PositionSummary.description: Same complete qualified financial evaluations as expanded Position; excludes navigation/sourceIdentifiers, never suppresses warnings for shown conclusions.

OtherLeaf.description: Uninterpreted supported source inventory remains visible; no standard financial payoff or named model is inferred.

WholeContracts.description: Positive whole contract count. Fractional shares/cash are separate typed units.

ReferenceEvidence.description: Shared non-Account reference only. No Account Artifact UUID, upload locator or private evidence is allowed.

RedactedEvidence.description: No source identity, Account-upload locator, Order existence or protected values are disclosed.

ReferenceOptionTerms.description: Standard intrinsic requires positively verified terms. Same symbol/expiry/strike/right alone does not prove equal deliverables. Adjusted terms remain visible even when payoff is unsupported. Individually missing terms remain null while known terms survive; qualification prevents standard payoff claims. This is not permission to guess a multiplier.

AssociationAuthority.description: Names the relationship predicate, not merely a typed source pointer. Source contract, scope, content and completeness must substantiate this claim under ADR-016. No operator association workflow or specific-share selection is introduced.

GlobalAllocation.description: Status is derived over all current allocations at declared Account holding cuts, not from one tree. CONFLICT propagates to every dependent held evaluation; residual is not buying power.

EconomicPeriod.description: Historical loss floor is not current protection. Long call rights do not establish current share ownership.

CumulativeEconomics.description: Separate documented cash-flow sums from realized P/L and remaining open proceeds. Missing history makes full cumulative result incomplete; documented subtotals may remain QUALIFIED. Economic break-even is not tax basis. No implied strategy or share-selection engine.

EconomicComparison.description: Optional detailed Position comparison, reusing immutable Construction history and reported Orders/Transactions. No separate resource, strategy identity or inferred execution events.
